question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated authority within the Chinese Communist Party underpins the strong trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Through sustained purges of senior military and political figures, including multiple Central Military Commission members, he has eliminated potential rivals while promoting loyal technocrats, with no public signs of elite coordination against his leadership. At age 73, Xi shows no indication of stepping down ahead of the 21st Party Congress scheduled for late 2027, where age norms are expected to apply mainly to others and he is positioned to secure a fourth term. Historical patterns of centralized control and the lack of designated successors further reinforce stability expectations. Even so, an unforeseen health event or abrupt shift in elite alignments could still introduce uncertainty within the narrow timeframe.
